title: Multiply Strings
description: Multiply two non-negative integers represented as strings.
pseudocode:
1. let res = new Array(n + m).fill(0)
2. for i = n - 1 down to 0:
3.   for j = m - 1 down to 0:
4.     let mul = (num1[i]) * (num2[j])
5.     let sum = mul + res[i + j + 1]
6.     res[i + j + 1] = sum % 10
7.     res[i + j] += Math.floor(sum / 10)

steps.note: Initialize result array of size len1 + len2 with zeros.
Start outer loop i = 0 for num1 = '2'.
Start inner loop j = 0 for num2 = '3'.
Add product to existing value at res[i+j+1].
Add carry to res[i+j], resulting in final array.
